title: Late Posting of Summit Choice-Benefit Bonus Miles
content:
When a Crestline Summit Loyalty Program choice-benefit selection of bonus miles is credited late, the selection miles are treated according to the delay, counted in calendar days from the selection's date to the day the credit posts.

**Clause.**

- More than 180 days: the selection miles are multiplied by 1.25 and rounded up to the next thousand miles.
- More than 30 and up to 180 days: a flat 1000 miles is added to the selection miles, with no multiplying.
- Within 30 days: the selection miles are carried unchanged.

The selection miles are the bonus miles per selection of the tier the member holds; the selection is the latest selection of bonus miles on the membership.

### Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Selection miles | Days from selection to posting | Result of this clause |
|---|---|---|
| 25000 | 181 | 32000 (25000 by 1.25 is 31250, rounded up to the thousand) |
| 20000 | 181 | 25000 (exactly 25000, already a whole thousand) |
| 30000 | 180 | 31000 |
| 30000 | 31 | 31000 |
| 30000 | 30 | 30000 |

Day 30 is still within the unchanged span, day 180 still within the flat-addition span.
